title: Task-SEEG recordings from epilepsy patients performing a visual working memory task (Tian, Figshare 32189838)
description: Stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) recordings from seven patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual working memory task. Depth electrodes were placed solely for clinical evaluation, and continuous 2048 Hz recordings are provided in BIDS iEEG format. The data support investigation of the neural mechanisms of working memory, including hippocampal and frontal eye field activity.
methods_description: Intracranial multi-contact depth electrodes (8-16 contacts) were stereotactically implanted with robotic assistance. Signals were recorded with a Nicolet EEG amplifier at 2048 Hz, using a white matter online reference selected by the clinical team. Participants performed a visual working memory task.
